title: Community Cleanup Records
summary: Follow two public record trails to identify who coordinated an unreported river cleanup.

setting.location: Public notices, event pages, and photo records hosted across several fictional sites

startingSituation: A local reporter found a public cleanup notice and a separate photo page that may describe the same event.
playerCapabilities: inspect accessible page metadata and source
playerConstraints: do not contact real people or access private accounts

startingInputs.description: The public notice page where the investigation begins.
A public community photo page linked in the reporter's notes.

phases.title: Review the Starting Records
phases.summary: Examine the notice and photo page for details that identify the event.

phases.title: Find the Project Update
phases.summary: Use the project name to locate the city's corrected meeting notice.

phases.title: Confirm the Coordinator
phases.summary: Combine the date and meeting place to find the matching public event recap.

puzzles.title: Inspect the Cleanup Notice
puzzles.purpose: Inspect the public notice source to recover the project name used on the city project site.

generationSpec.visibleBody: Volunteers are invited to help with a riverbank cleanup. The project name was removed from the visible notice during an update.

verification.prompt: Enter the project name found in the page source using uppercase letters.

inputs.use: Open the supplied public notice URL and inspect the page source for the removed project name.

outputs.description: The project name used to locate its page on the city projects site.

preview.title: Weekend Volunteer Notice
preview.body: A short public notice describes a riverbank cleanup and indicates that an identifying line was removed during an update.

puzzles.title: Read the Photo Description
puzzles.purpose: Inspect the accessible description of the community photo to recover the cleanup date.

generationSpec.visibleBody: The page contains one photograph from a recent volunteer cleanup.
generationSpec.altText: Volunteers gathered at the North River boardwalk on April 18 2026, standing beside filled cleanup bags.

verification.prompt: Enter the event date as MONTH DAY YEAR in uppercase letters.

inputs.use: Open the supplied community photo page and inspect the photograph's accessible description.

outputs.description: The cleanup date used with the meeting place to identify the matching event recap.

preview.description: A public photo page shows volunteers standing beside bags collected during a river cleanup.

puzzles.title: Compare the Project Notices
puzzles.purpose: Use the project name to find its city page, then compare notice versions to recover the corrected meeting place.

generationSpec.baselineBody: Volunteers should meet at the west parking lot before the cleanup.
generationSpec.currentBody: Correction: volunteers should meet at the east pier before the cleanup.

verification.prompt: Enter the corrected meeting place using uppercase letters.

inputs.use: Search the fictional city projects site for the River Cleanup page and open its notice history.

outputs.description: The corrected meeting place used with the event date to find the matching public recap.

data.comparison: The earlier and corrected notices list different meeting places.

puzzles.title: Inspect the Event Recap
puzzles.purpose: Use the cleanup date and meeting place to find the matching recap and identify the coordinator named in its source.

generationSpec.visibleBody: This public recap confirms the cleanup date and meeting place but does not show the coordinator's name in the visible article.

verification.prompt: Enter the coordinator's full name using uppercase letters.

inputs.use: Filter the fictional community events archive to recaps dated April 18 2026.
Select the April 18 recap that names East Pier as its meeting place.

outputs.description: The coordinator's name submitted as the investigation's final finding.

preview.title: River Cleanup Event Recap
preview.body: A public recap confirms the date and meeting place. Its article markup contains a coordinator field.

terminalAction.title: Submit the Coordinator's Name
terminalAction.description: Submit the name of the person who coordinated the cleanup described by the public records.
terminalAction.successOutcome: The report links the public notice, project correction, photograph, and event recap to the same cleanup.

requiredResources.description: A volunteer notice whose source contains the cleanup project name.
A community photo page whose accessible image description contains the event date.
A city project page with earlier and corrected meeting instructions.
An event recap whose source identifies the coordinator.
A final form that accepts the coordinator's name.
